title: Boone County Planning Commission — Sign Permit drawing-copy corroboration decision
candidate: Current Sign Permit application changed from three submitted drawing copies to one submitted drawing copy.
reason: The current official Sign Permit application itself establishes the one-copy wording, but the separately verified current checklist evidence establishes checklist identity/listing only and does not independently establish or corroborate the submitted-drawing copy count. The adopted Article 34 archive references submitted drawings but the inspected indexed evidence does not establish a drawing-copy count.
useRule: Keep submitted_drawing_copy_count as a current-form change candidate. Do not promote one copy into automated authoritative permit requirements until another current official source explicitly corroborates the count or staff approves it.
evidenceScope: This is a conservative corroboration decision, not a claim that one copy is incorrect. It preserves the current form wording while preventing a single changed form field from silently becoming authoritative workflow guidance without independent support.
